Abdul El-Sayed on Trump:
We are being actively bullied by the dumbest people in the room. And I mean, Donald Trump is an idiot.
Whatever you think about him, he has one genius, which is the genius of getting attention, because his dad never gave him enough.
Because he was a nepo baby, because he had resources, he realized quickly that he just craved attention and then used the bullying tactics that he uses right now to get it.
But the man is an idiot. I mean, just when it comes down to it, just a fool.

Abdul El-Sayed:
JD Vance is a smart person, but he has no actual soul and he has no actual charisma.
And so his thing is just to suck up to the strongest person in the room to do their bidding.

Abdul El-Sayed:
Trump has tactics. He doesn't have strategies.
Strategies require a kind of patience and a kind of long-term thinking about the consequences of your actions.
Trump has never shown long-term thinking about the consequences of his actions, nor has he ever shown any discipline about being able to persist in a process.
